milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a red tulip by hand drops it as an item that enters the player's inventory. The scene has 5 red tulips available, so the agent only needs to successfully break one.

Uses inventory_has because crafting white_dye from bone_meal (1:1 shapeless recipe) places the result in the player's inventory. Bone meal is provided in a chest and white_dye is not in the starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting iron_door (6 iron ingots in 2x3 pattern → 3 iron doors) places the result in the player's inventory. Iron ingots are provided in a chest and iron_door is not in the starting inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because interacting with the smithing table requires the player to be close to it and facing it (to right-click). The smithing table is at spawn-relative (-2, 0, 6). Max distance of 3 ensures the player is within interaction range, and facing_tolerance of 60 degrees confirms they are oriented toward it. This is the best available proxy for block interaction since no interact_with_block rule type exists.
